([[Detroit, Michigan]]) | college = [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State]] (2016–2020) | highlights = * 2× Consensus second-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2019 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2019]], [[2020 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2020]]) * [[Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Big Ten Player of the Year]] (2019) * 2× First-team All [[Big Ten Conference|Big Ten]] (2019, 2020) * Third-team All-Big Ten (2018) * [[Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Tournament|Big Ten Tournament]] MOP ([[2019 Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Tournament|2019]]) * [[Mr. Basketball of Michigan]] (2016) * [[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2016) | medal_templates = }} '''Cassius Winston''' (born February 28, 1998) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State Spartans]]. ==High school career== Winston, a 6'1 [[point guard]], was a star prep player at [[University of Detroit Jesuit High School and Academy]] in [[Detroit]]. As a senior in 2016, he led his team to an MHSAA Class A State Championship, and was named [[Mr. Basketball of Michigan]].{{cite web |last = McCabe | first = Mick | title=Cassius Winston named Michigan's Mr. Basketball|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/high-school/2016/03/21/cassius-winston-michigan-mr-basketball/82074404/ |work=[[Detroit Free Press]] |accessdate=January 30, 2019|date=March 21, 2016}} In 2020, Winston will be inducted into the [[Catholic High School League]] Hall of Fame. ===Recruiting=== {{College athlete recruit start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2016}} overall = 31 | accessdate = April 1, 2019 | bball = yes }} ==College career== [[File:Cassius Winston 2020.jpg|thumb|left|Winston in February 2020]] He chose to attend college at [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State]],{{cite web |last = O’Donnell | first = Ricky | title=4-star PG Cassius Winston commits to Michigan State, puts Tom Izzo on brink of his best recruiting class ever |url=https://www.sbnation.com/college-basketball/2015/9/18/9352055/cassius-winston-michigan-state-recruiting-miles-bridges |work=[[SBNation.com]] |accessdate=January 30, 2019|date=September 18, 2015}} and in his freshman season averaged 6.7 points and 5.2 assists per game in 35 games.{{cite web |last = Solari | first = Chris | title=MSU's Cassius Winston plans summer packed with court time |url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/michigan-state/spartans/2017/06/30/michigan-state-basketball-cassius-winston/443298001/ |work=[[Detroit Free Press]] |accessdate=January 30, 2019|date=June 13, 2017}} As a sophomore, he became a full-time starter, averaging 12.6 points and 6.9 assists per game for the Spartans, and earning third-team All-[[Big Ten Conference]] honors.{{cite web |last = Austin | first = Kyle | title=Michigan State's Cassius Winston's recent play could make him a Big Ten Player of the Year contender |url=https://www.ncaa.com/news/basketball-men/article/2019-01-18/michigan-state-basketball-cassius-winston-stats-big-ten |work=[[NCAA.com]] |accessdate=January 30, 2019|date=January 18, 2019}} Entering into Winston's junior season, he was selected to the preseason All-Big Ten team.{{cite web |last = Austin | first = Kyle | title=Preseason writers poll predicts Big 10 conference win for MSU, second for Michigan|url=https://www.mlive.com/sports/2018/10/preseason_writers_poll_predict.html |work=[[MLive]] |accessdate=January 30, 2019|date=October 10, 2018}} After a strong start to the year, he was named to the midseason watch list for the [[John R. Wooden Award]].{{cite web |last = Sullivan | first = Crowley | title=Wooden Award Midseason Top 25 - Is Cassius Properly Positioned?|url=https://spartanswire.usatoday.com/2019/01/10/wooden-award-midseason-top-25-is-cassius-properly-positioned/ |work=[[USA Today]] |accessdate=January 30, 2019|date=January 10, 2019}} On March 11, 2019, Winston was named the [[Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Big Ten Player of the Year]].{{cite web|url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/college/michigan-state-university/2019/03/11/michigan-state-spartans-cassius-winston-named-big-ten-player-year/3129147002/|title=Michigan State's Cassius Winston named Big Ten Player of Year; Tillman top sixth man|work=The Detroit News|date= March 11, 2019|first=Matt|last=Charboneau|accessdate=April 1, 2019}} On March 31, 2019, Winston scored 20 points and obtained 10 assists in a 68–67 win against [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] in the [[Elite Eight]] of the [[2019 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament]].{{cite news |title=Michigan State knocks off Duke 68-67 to make Final Four |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401123387 |accessdate=January 18, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=March 31, 2019}} Prior to the start of the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]], Winston was unanimously named a preseason All-American by the [[Associated Press]] (AP), the only player so honored.{{cite web |last = Marshall | first = John | title= Michigan State basketball Cassius Winston: Only consensus preseason AP All-American |url= https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/michigan-state/spartans/2019/10/22/michigan-states-cassius-winston-preseason-ap-all-american/4063866002/ |work=[[Detroit Free Press]] |accessdate=November 2, 2019|date=October 22, 2019}} On December 29, Winston missed a game against [[Western Michigan Broncos men's basketball|Western Michigan]] with a bone bruise in his knee.{{cite news |title=Michigan State's Cassius Winston out with bone bruise in knee |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28392904/michigan-state-cassius-winston-bone-bruise-knee |accessdate=December 30, 2019 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=December 29, 2019}} He scored a career-high 32 points along with nine assists in a 87–69 win over [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]] on January 5, 2020.{{cite news |last1=Solari |first1=Chris |title=Michigan State basketball witnessed quintessential Cassius Winston; so did Michigan |url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/michigan-state/spartans/2020/01/05/michigan-state-basketball-michigan-analysis-cassius-winston/2821109001/ |accessdate=January 5, 2020 |work=[[Detroit Free Press]] |date=January 5, 2020}} Winston passed [[Mateen Cleaves]]' Big Ten record of 816 assists on January 17, in a win against [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin]].{{cite news |title=Cassius Winston's 817th career assist breaks former fellow Spartan Mateen Cleaves' record |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28504993/cassius-winston-817th-career-assist-breaks-former-fellow-spartan-mateen-cleaves-record |accessdate=January 18, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=January 17, 2020}} At the close of the regular season, Winston was named to the First Team All-Big Ten by the coaches and media.{{cite press release|url=https://bigten.org/news/2020/3/9/big-ten-unveils-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-on-btn.aspx|title=Big Ten Unveils Men’s Basketball Postseason Honors on BTN|publisher=[[Big Ten Conference]] |date=March 9, 2020 |accessdate=March 9, 2020}} Winston averaged 18.3 points and 5.9 assists per game as a senior.{{cite news |last1=Dauster |first1=Rob |title=NBC Sports College Basketball All-American Teams |url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2020/03/10/college-basketball-all-american-teams/ |accessdate=March 16, 2020 |work=[[NBC Sports]] |date=March 10, 2020}}
